blocks.text: The opening

**These are Tilde fobs: coins and tags for your keys, with an NFC sticker inside.** Tap one with a phone and it opens whatever’s on the sticker: a link, your contact card, your Wi-Fi. The tags have a QR code too. The box holds a few; here’s every shape, color and icon.
How it works

items.text: **Tap it.** Any phone with NFC reads the sticker inside, and the other person doesn’t need an app.

**Change it any time.** A phone rewrites the sticker through the plastic, so the same fob can open something new without a reprint. You only open it to replace the sticker. `[depends on U15]` If Tilde protected the sticker, only the phone that wrote it can change it. `[depends on T-S1, T-S2]`
**Scan a tag.** A tag’s QR code opens a short link (up to 53 characters, such as a website). The code is printed, so it doesn’t change. A coin has no code: it’s for tapping only.
**You print it yourself** on a multi-color printer, in two pieces with no pause. Or pick up a tag at our booth.

Thin, quick and cheap to print. The back twists on a quarter turn and locks. Open it by hand, or with a coin in its slot if you add one.

blocks.text: per fob type: base coin, base tag, premium coin, premium tag; a tag's front (the code) and back (the icon)

**A tag’s size follows its link.** A base tag is 28.8 × 35.3 mm for up to 17 characters, 31 × 37.5 mm for up to 32, and 35 × 41.5 mm for up to 53. A premium tag is 36 × 44 mm for up to 32 characters, and 37 × 44.5 mm for up to 53. A link is all a tag’s code holds: a contact card is far too much for a code this small. `[depends on U16]` for “scans”.
Colors

Our table has three color sets, each two colors, made with the model’s color options. In these three, the code takes the body’s color, with no patch of another color. `[depends on T-B1]` for orange on black and khaki on black.
In the model, a tag’s code sits on a light field unless you choose otherwise (**QR Background**).
each fob type in each color set
**Special:** the pocket case fobs, orange, with black icons and the code black on white. They ride in the card pocket cases (see Cards).
The model’s Theme menu has the cards’ themes (Dark, Light, Signal, USA, Brasil, Portugal and Retro), not our three sets. Or pick your own colors.

The storage box
A 2 × 2 box of flat stacks: 3 premium coins, 3 premium tags, 5 base coins and 8 base tags, under a sliding lid with the wordmark engraved. We made it for the booth. Its print files aren’t published.
the storage box, closed and open
Icons
**Tell a set apart** with an icon on the back, and a short label if you like, in a color you choose. Every icon is generic: no brand logos, so a chat bubble rather than any app’s logo.
one image per built icon, with its name from the model and its line from `icon-uses.json`
How to get one

items.text: **Print your own.** Click **Customize** on the Tilde Keyrings listing on MakerWorld (MAKERWORLD-KEYRINGS-URL): choose a coin or a tag, Base or Premium, your colors and your icon, then download the 3MF.
**Add a round NFC sticker** and write it with Tilde (Android: Cards → Write a sticker) or the free NFC Tools app (iPhone and Android).
**Or pick one up at our booth.** Take a tag from the giveaway boxes, and we’ll show you how to write it (see the Uses page).
